purpose: Teach: ときには/何一つ/御飯/もうけ/たずね/そうこう/おみやげ/壊れる

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ときには甘えてもいいのよ
lines.en: Sometimes it's okay to lean on people, Sho.
lines.style: Warm and inviting, spoken close. Gentle opening on his name. Patient breath. The kind of tenderness that makes vulnerability feel safe, not burdensome.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、何一つ忘れずに持ってきたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I remembered to bring everything.
lines.style: Clear pride in his voice, but quiet — not boastful. Straightforward delivery. A small boy announcing something he worked hard to do, waiting to see if she noticed.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんが御飯を作ってくださってるわ
lines.en: Your grandma's made us dinner, sweetheart.
lines.style: Soft, matter-of-fact. A gentle redirect. Warmth underneath, but the focus is practical — this is what's happening next, and it's good.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんが、お祭りでもうけたって
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad made some money at the festival!
lines.style: Excited, open-mouthed quality. Bright with the news, wanting to share something good. Quick pace, genuine. Not performed excitement — the real thing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ご近所さんがたずねていらしたのよ
lines.en: A neighbor came by while we were out.
lines.style: Calm, informational. A soft pause after the fact, as if mentioning it in passing. No urgency, just the natural flow of what happened during the day.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、そうこうしてるうちに夕方になっちゃった
lines.en: Mei-sis, before I knew it, evening had come.
lines.style: A hint of wry observation underneath innocence. Slow, noticing. The tone of a child realizing time passed without him paying attention. Slightly bemused at himself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖父ちゃんにおみやげ、何にするか考えようね
lines.en: Let's think about what souvenir to get Grandpa, okay?
lines.style: Inviting him into a small decision together. Warm and collaborative. Opening soft on the question, letting him have space to think alongside her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくの大事なおもちゃ、壊れるのは嫌だよ
lines.en: My favorite toy — I don't want it to break.
lines.style: Serious, direct, with real concern underneath. No drama. The careful precision of a child protecting something that matters. Vulnerable but steady.
